lines.text: Forty-four percent of American adults have now used ChatGPT.
In 2023, it was eighteen percent. Under thirty, it is sixty-one most of a generation has walked in.
And nearly every one of them met the model the same way: inside a chat box rented from one company.
Close the tab, and nothing stays with you not the instructions you shaped, not the memory you built, not the files you made.
Half a country has walked in. Almost none of them were handed a key.
We count the adoption and teach the ownership. Follow for the next count.
